transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… things at work have been feeling off. Dispatch and compliance keep watching my route changes through the computer, and there are these little comments on the radio. People say it’s just normal oversight, but… I can tell some of the drivers are reporting on me.
Do you think these comments on the radio and the oversight are specifically targeting you?

Yeah… I mean, it feels that way. The route changes get tracked in the system, and then there’ll be these little radio comments after. I know people say it’s just oversight, but certain drivers… I think they’re reporting on me.
Do you think there's any other explanation for the comments and oversight besides people targeting you?

I mean… people keep saying it’s just normal oversight. Maybe that’s what they’d call it. But with the route changes being tracked and then those little radio comments after, it doesn’t feel random. Certain drivers are reporting on me, I can tell.
Do you ever think that these comments and oversight might stop or change if you did something differently?

Maybe… I don’t know. I try to keep my route changes clean, follow the system, but they still get tracked. And then the radio comments happen anyway. So I’m not sure it would stop just because I did something different.
Do you think there's anything you could do to prove or disprove that these drivers are reporting on you?

I don’t really know how I’d prove it. I mean, the route changes are in the computer, and then the radio comments happen after… so to me that’s kind of the pattern. But if I asked, they’d probably just say it’s normal oversight.
Do you think there's anything that could ever convince you that the drivers are not reporting on you?

I don’t know. If the radio comments stopped completely, maybe… or if I could see somehow that nobody was looking at my route changes. But right now it feels like they are, and people saying it’s just oversight doesn’t really convince me.
Do you think your belief that drivers are reporting on you could be wrong?

I guess it could be… I mean, I know people keep saying it’s just normal oversight. But it doesn’t feel wrong when the route changes show up in the system and then certain drivers make those radio comments. It feels connected.
Do you think your belief about the drivers reporting on you will ever change?

I don’t know… maybe if it all actually stopped. But right now, with the route changes in the computer and then those radio comments from certain drivers, it still feels like they’re reporting on me. So… I can’t really say it’ll change.
Do you think you will ever be completely certain that the drivers are reporting on you, or is there already no doubt in your mind?

I don’t know if I’d say there’s no doubt at all… but it’s pretty clear to me. When I change routes and then it shows up in the system, and certain drivers make those comments over the radio, it feels like they’re reporting on me. People can call it normal oversight, but… I don’t really buy that.
Do you think anyone or anything could ever change your mind about the drivers reporting on you?

Maybe… I don’t know. If there was some real proof it wasn’t happening, maybe. But when the computer shows the route changes and then certain drivers make those radio comments, it’s hard for me to just believe it’s nothing.
Do you think your belief about the drivers reporting on you is something that might be open to change based on new information?

I guess… maybe, if there was something solid. But from what I’ve seen, dispatch and compliance can track the route changes in the computer, and then I hear those little comments on the radio from certain drivers. So when people say it’s just normal oversight, I don’t really believe that right now.
Do you think your belief that the drivers are reporting on you is something that you could be mistaken about?

I mean… I guess anyone could be mistaken. But it doesn’t feel that way to me. With the computer tracking the route changes, and then those little radio comments from certain drivers… it seems pretty clear they’re reporting on me.
Do you think the belief that drivers are reporting on you is a thought that you can control or is it something that pops into your mind on its own?

It kind of pops in on its own. I’ll be doing my route and then I notice the computer changes, or I hear a driver make some little comment on the radio, and it just… it feels connected. I don’t really choose to think it.
Do you think there's any situation where you would completely accept that the drivers are not reporting on you?

Maybe if there was a clear reason for all of it that made sense… like the route changes and the radio comments weren’t connected. But right now, no, I don’t think I could completely accept that. It feels too much like certain drivers are reporting on me.
Have you felt like people were watching or reporting on you in other parts of your life, outside of work?

Not really in other places… at least not like this. It’s mostly at work, with dispatch and compliance and the route changes on the computer. And the radio comments from certain drivers. That’s where I notice it.
Do you think your belief that the drivers are reporting on you could change even if someone explained it in a different way?

I don’t know… I guess someone could explain it, but it doesn’t really change how it feels. They say it’s normal oversight, but with the computer changes and the radio comments, I can still tell certain drivers are reporting on me.
Do you often feel like people are watching or trying to harm you when you're not at work?
No… not really. It’s mostly when I’m at work. With dispatch, compliance, the computer route changes… and certain drivers on the radio. That’s where it feels like I’m being tracked or reported on.
Do you think the belief that drivers are reporting on you is based on facts or is it just a feeling you have?

It feels like facts to me. I mean… it’s the computer route changes, and the way dispatch and compliance track them, and then certain drivers make comments on the radio. People say it’s just normal oversight, but I can tell it’s more than that.
Do you ever find it hard to express your thoughts or feelings in a way that makes sense to others?

Yeah… sometimes. I don’t always explain things clearly, I guess. At work I’ve gotten behind on route reports, and my instructions to drivers get confusing enough that they complain. At home… my husband’s been handling more of the meals and calls and planning, because I’m not really keeping up.
Do you often find yourself having trouble organizing your thoughts when talking to others?

Yeah… I guess so. It comes out mixed up sometimes, especially at work. I’ve fallen behind on the route reports, and drivers complain that my instructions don’t make sense. At home my husband’s been taking over more… meals, phone calls, planning things… because I’m not really keeping up.
